conflicts.permit: We may share personally identifiable information (such as name, address, email or phone) with trusted partners in order to provide you with relevant advertising, offers or services.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect personally identifiable information about you.
conflicts.situation: When handling personally identifiable information such as a user's name, address, phone number, or email address.
conflicts.reason: Section II(2) explicitly denies collecting PII, but Section IV(1) permits sharing collected PII with trusted partners without reconciling the contradiction.

conflicts.permit: You can sign into your account to see or delete any personally identifiable information we have stored, such as your name, address, email or phone number.
conflicts.prohibit: In other words, we do not collect information such as your name, address, phone number or email address.
conflicts.situation: When managing or retaining user account data like name, address, email, or phone number.
conflicts.reason: The policy unequivocally states it does not collect such PII, yet later states it stores it in connection with user accounts.
